terms_intro_p1: By using our website or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these Terms. Please read them carefully.
terms_definitions_p1: 'We', 'us' and 'our' refer to the operator of this website. 'You' refers to the person using the website or placing an order.
terms_definitions_p2: 'Products' means jewellery items, accessories and related services offered via the website.
terms_use_of_website_p1: You must not use the website for fraudulent or unlawful purposes and must comply with any usage instructions.
terms_use_of_website_p2: We may modify, suspend or discontinue the website (or any part) at any time without notice.

terms_order_acceptance_p2: We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order for reasons including product unavailability, pricing errors or payment issues.

terms_returns_cancellations_p2: Custom, personalised or engraved items are generally non-returnable unless faulty.

terms_intellectual_property_p2: You may not reproduce, copy or reuse website materials without our prior written consent.
terms_custom_orders_p1: Custom or bespoke jewellery is produced to your specifications and is non-cancellable once production has started.
terms_custom_orders_p2: Please ensure you provide accurate size/specification information. We cannot guarantee sizing beyond reasonable tolerances.

privacy_intro_p1: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
privacy_data_controller_p1: We are the data controller responsible for the processing of your personal data in connection with the website and our services.
privacy_data_we_collect_p1: Personal data you provide: name, email, address, telephone number, order history and payment information (processed via payment providers).
privacy_data_we_collect_p2: Technical and usage data: IP address, device and browser information, pages visited and timestamps collected automatically.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p1: We use your data to process orders, manage your account and provide customer service.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p2: We may use data to personalise your experience, improve the website and for fraud prevention and legal compliance.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p3: Marketing communications are sent only with your consent; you can withdraw consent at any time.
privacy_legal_basis_p1: We process personal data where necessary for contract performance, to comply with legal obligations, with your consent or based on our legitimate interests.
privacy_data_sharing_p1: We share data with service providers such as payment processors, logistics and analytics providers who process data on our behalf under contract.
privacy_data_sharing_p2: International transfers outside the EEA will be protected by appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.
privacy_cookies_p1: We use cookies to enable site functionality and analytics. You can manage or disable cookies via your browser settings.
privacy_data_retention_p1: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected and to meet legal obligations.
privacy_your_rights_p1: You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your personal data and may object to processing where applicable.
privacy_your_rights_p2: To exercise your rights, contact us. You may also lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority in your jurisdiction.
privacy_security_p1: We implement technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, but no internet transmission can be guaranteed 100% secure.
privacy_minors_p1: Our services are not directed to children under 16. If we learn that we have collected data from a minor without consent, we will delete it.
privacy_policy_changes_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy; material changes will be communicated via the website or email.
privacy_contact_p1: For privacy inquiries contact us at the address provided on the website. You may also contact the applicable supervisory authority in your jurisdiction.
